mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units signals strong residential demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1500 thousand units, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates for equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% indicates a supply shock and labor market weakness, which typically compresses corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery (UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive 60-day forward returns as improved employment conditions boost consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained acceleration in the annualized CPIAUCSL growth rate above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to delay rate cuts and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL growth rate exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) growth rate above 5.0% annualized signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS growth rate exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% MoM and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 8.0% indicates a tight labor market, which typically leads to higher corporate wage costs and reduced profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE < 8.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 101.0 indicates expanding supply capacity, which typically leads to lower inflation and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate margins improve.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 101.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
